#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# check-architecture.sh - Verify layer boundary constraints
#
# Checks that:
# 1. No Node.js core modules (fs, path, os, child_process) in renderer code
# 2. No Electron IPC imports in service code
# 3. No React imports in services or main process code
#
# Exit code 0 = all checks pass
# Exit code 1 = violations found

set -euo pipefail

VIOLATIONS=0

echo "=== Architecture Boundary Checks ==="
echo ""

# Check 1: No fs/path imports in renderer
echo "Checking renderer for Node.js core module imports..."
RENDERER_FILES=$(find src/renderer -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$RENDERER_FILES" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    if grep -qE "import.*\b(fs|path|os|child_process)\b" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  VIOLATION: $file imports Node.js core module"
      VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))
    fi
  done <<< "$RENDERER_FILES"
fi
if [ "$VIOLATIONS" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  PASS: No Node.js core imports in renderer"
fi
echo ""

# Check 2: No Electron IPC in services
echo "Checking services for Electron IPC imports..."
SERVICE_FILES=$(find src/services -name '*.ts' 2>/dev/null || true)
SVIO=0
if [ -n "$SERVICE_FILES" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    if grep -qE "import.*from\s+['\"]electron['\"]" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  VIOLATION: $file imports from electron"
      VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))
      SVIO=$((SVIO + 1))
    fi
    if grep -qE "\bipcMain\b|\bipcRenderer\b|\bBrowserWindow\b" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  VIOLATION: $file uses Electron IPC"
      VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))
      SVIO=$((SVIO + 1))
    fi
  done <<< "$SERVICE_FILES"
fi
if [ "$SVIO" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  PASS: No Electron IPC in services"
fi
echo ""

# Check 3: No React imports in services or main
echo "Checking services and main for React imports..."
BACKEND_FILES=$(find src/services src/main -name '*.ts' 2>/dev/null || true)
RVIO=0
if [ -n "$BACKEND_FILES" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    if grep -qE "import.*from\s+['\"]react['\"]" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  VIOLATION: $file imports React"
      VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))
      RVIO=$((RVIO + 1))
    fi
  done <<< "$BACKEND_FILES"
fi
if [ "$RVIO" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  PASS: No React imports in services/main"
fi
echo ""

# Check 4: the preload must not load local modules at runtime while the sandbox is on
echo "Checking preload for local requires under the sandbox..."
if [ -f dist/preload/preload.js ] && grep -qE "require\(['\"]\.\.?/" dist/preload/preload.js; then
  if ! grep -qE "sandbox:\s*false" src/main/main.ts 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "  VIOLATION: dist/preload/preload.js requires a local file while the sandbox is on"
    echo "  WHY: a sandboxed preload cannot load local modules, so window.knowledgeBase is undefined and the UI cannot reach the app"
    echo "  FIX: bundle the preload into a single file (for example with esbuild) or keep it free of local imports. Do not disable the sandbox."
    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))
  fi
else
  echo "  PASS: preload has no local runtime requires (or is not built yet)"
fi
echo ""

# Summary
echo "=== Summary ==="
if [ "$VIOLATIONS" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: $VIOLATIONS violation(s) found"
  exit 1
else
  echo "PASS: All architecture boundary checks passed"
  exit 0
fi
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Abre la app real y comprueba que la interfaz tenga acceso a la API (window.knowledgeBase).
# Es la verificación de capa 3 mínima: si falla, la app compila pero el usuario no puede hacer nada.
set -u
PORT="${1:-9350}"
DATA="$(mktemp -d)"
env -u NODE_OPTIONS npx electron . --remote-debugging-port="$PORT" --user-data-dir="$DATA" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
PID=$!
OUT=""
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  OUT="$(node --experimental-websocket scripts/check-bridge.mjs "$PORT" 2>/dev/null)" && break
  sleep 1
done
kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$DATA"
echo "$OUT"
if echo "$OUT" | grep -q '"bridge": "object"'; then
  echo "PASS: the running app exposes window.knowledgeBase"
else
  echo "FAIL: the running app does not expose window.knowledgeBase"
  echo "WHY: the preload did not load, so every button in the UI is disconnected from the app"
  echo "FIX: run 'bash scripts/check-architecture.sh' and follow its preload instructions, rebuild, and run this script again"
  exit 1
fi
// Se conecta por Chrome DevTools a una app Electron abierta con --remote-debugging-port
// y pregunta si la ventana tiene acceso a la API del preload (window.knowledgeBase).
// Uso: node --experimental-websocket scripts/check-bridge.mjs [puerto]
const port = process.argv[2] || '9333';
const targets = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/list`)).json();
const page = targets.find((t) => t.type === 'page');
if (!page) { console.log('No hay ventana abierta'); process.exit(2); }
const ws = new WebSocket(page.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
await new Promise((r) => ws.addEventListener('open', r));
const ask = (expression) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const id = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9);
  ws.addEventListener('message', function onMsg(ev) {
    const msg = JSON.parse(ev.data);
    if (msg.id === id) { ws.removeEventListener('message', onMsg); resolve(msg.result?.result?.value); }
  });
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method: 'Runtime.evaluate', params: { expression, returnByValue: true } }));
});
const bridge = await ask('typeof window.knowledgeBase');
const keys = await ask('window.knowledgeBase ? Object.keys(window.knowledgeBase).join(",") : ""');
const text = await ask('document.body.innerText.slice(0, 300)');
console.log(JSON.stringify({ bridge, keys, text }, null, 2));
ws.close();
const { execSync } = require('child_process');
const path = require('path');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

console.log('[dev] Building main + preload...');
try {
  execSync('npx tsc -p tsconfig.node.json', { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' });
} catch {
  console.error('[dev] TypeScript compilation failed');
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log('[dev] Building renderer...');
try {
  execSync('npx vite build', { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' });
} catch {
  console.error('[dev] Vite build failed');
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log('[dev] Starting Electron...');
try {
  execSync('npx electron .', { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' });
} catch {
  // Electron exits with code 0 on normal close
}
